notablePrerequisites:
Animate Land and Utopia Sprawl attached to Selesnya Sanctuary.
Selesnya Sanctuary does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Selesnya Sanctuary.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Selesnya Sanctuary to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Repeat.
